title.narrative: Market Aggregation, Linking Markets and Innovation (MALI)

description.narrative: The project intervention changes into an Expanded and Integrated Market Aggregation, Linking Markets and Innovation (IMALI). It transforms into a layering and holistic approach to increasing access to incomes for cumulative 500 Smallholder Farmers (SHF) and informal traders 2000 by end of year 2026 (micro - small entrepreneurs) while strengthening local economies by bringing together agro producers, traders, and service providers into organised, efficient, and inclusive market and business systems. The project will be implemented in Matabeleland South (Matobo & Umzingwane), Bulawayo metropolitan and Matabeleland North (Umguza & Tsholotsho), the new target is selected based on the 2024 Bulawayo City Rapid Scan which states posits that approximately 60% of horticulture products consumed in Bulawayo are sourced from Tsholotsho, with a significant portion produced by young women and men. Notably, Tsholotsho is renowned for its special animal fodder- lablab, which has gained increased market demand. Given its numerous community gardens supplying horticulture products to Bulawayo, Tsholotsho presents an ideal location for the expanded reach.
